content:
{
  "summary": "Identified 6 high-impact prompt issues causing F2, F4, F6 fatals. Top issues: (1) Bot closes before requirement confirmation (F4), (2) Bot closes with WhatsApp promise before collecting specs (F6), (3) Bot logs quantity without unit confirmation (F2), (4) Bot logs product details without updating corrected product type (F2). Each fix is a targeted rule addition or edit to prevent premature closure or bad data capture.",
  "fixes": [
    {
      "title": "Block premature closing before requirement confirmation",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot closes or cuts off mid-call before the buyer confirms the requirement, leaving leads unvalidated and dispositions wrong.",
      "prompt_section": "Closing Rules",
      "current_instruction": "Once a closing path is selected, do not continue requirement collection, seller probing, or intent handling.",
      "suggested_text": "Never enter a closing path (FINALISATION/end_interaction) until the buyer has explicitly confirmed the requirement. If the buyer is mid-sentence, still speaking, or has not confirmed the product, do not close. Instead, continue to collect or defer the missing detail to the seller.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents F4 and F6 fatals caused by closing before the buyer confirms or finishes speaking.",
      "calls_affected": 6,
      "fatal_codes": ["F4", "F6"],
      "example_call_ids": ["90643030", "91156571", "91156758", "90643029", "91046432", "91100843"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Require specification confirmation before WhatsApp close",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot promises WhatsApp seller details and closes before collecting required specs like tube type or capacity, causing F6.",
      "prompt_section": "FINALISATION",
      "current_instruction": "If Buyer Declines to connect with Live Seller: ... Call end_interaction with a closing message saying that ...",
      "suggested_text": "Before any WhatsApp/SMS close, verify that all required specification fields are collected and confirmed. If a spec is ambiguous, missing, or exhausted, briefly defer it to the seller in the close, but do not close with an empty or mismatched spec. Example: 'We noted the requirement. You can discuss the exact K2/K3 tube type with the seller.'",
      "why_it_helps": "Ensures leads are enriched with correct specs before closure, reducing F6.",
      "calls_affected": 3,
      "fatal_codes": ["F6"],
      "example_call_ids": ["91264775", "91156726", "91046471"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Capture quantity unit explicitly before logging",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot logs quantity like '1000' without confirming the unit, causing a critical mismatch for the seller.",
      "prompt_section": "Quantity Collection",
      "current_instruction": "Accept exact numbers, estimates, and ranges; store the range’s maximum.",
      "suggested_text": "When the buyer provides a quantity number, always confirm the unit in the same turn if not already clear from the product context or prior turns. If the buyer says a number without a unit, ask for the unit before storing @ quantity. Example: 'You said one thousand — is that pieces?'",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents F2 fatals where quantity is logged without unit confirmation.",
      "calls_affected": 1,
      "fatal_codes": ["F2"],
      "example_call_ids": ["90853053"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Update product name on explicit buyer correction",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot logs a corrected product type (liquid instead of powder) but keeps the old product name, creating a mismatched lead.",
      "prompt_section": "PRODUCT_CHANGE intent Handler",
      "current_instruction": "when user respond identify the intent of the buyer Whether the buyer is posing the positive intent towards the product requirement if so then consider it as the agreement for the product requirement and call the tool @ requested_another_product_tool.",
      "suggested_text": "If the buyer explicitly rejects the current @ product_name and provides a new product type in the same turn, update @ product_name to the new product and call @ requested_another_product_tool immediately. Do not log a success disposition with the old product name.",
      "why_it_helps": "Ensures product changes are reflected in the lead, preventing F2 fatals.",
      "calls_affected": 1,
      "fatal_codes": ["F2"],
      "example_call_ids": ["91063624"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Read back critical fields before closing",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot cuts off mid-sentence during closing, leaving the buyer hanging and the lead incomplete.",
      "prompt_section": "Conversation Closing Rules",
      "current_instruction": "Never ask a question after entering a closing path.",
      "suggested_text": "Before calling end_interaction, always deliver a complete, single-sentence closing that includes the buyer name, the product, and the next step (WhatsApp or live seller). Do not chain two closing sentences. If the call is ending, say the full closing in one breath.",
      "why_it_helps": "Reduces bot_cut_off fatals by making the closing atomic and complete.",
      "calls_affected": 4,
      "fatal_codes": ["F4"],
      "example_call_ids": ["90643053", "91046432", "91229317", "91046448"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Handle buyer mid-sentence during close",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot cuts off while the buyer is still speaking, especially when they add details after the bot's close.",
      "prompt_section": "Per-Turn Decision Procedure",
      "current_instruction": "Stop and wait for the buyer's response before each next step. Never chain two slots or two questions into one reply.",
      "suggested_text": "If the buyer is speaking when the bot is about to close, pause the close, capture the new detail, and only then proceed to finalisation or a new close. Never end the call while the buyer is mid-sentence.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents F4/F6 fatals from cutting off the buyer before they finish speaking.",
      "calls_affected": 2,
      "fatal_codes": ["F4", "F6"],
      "example_call_ids": ["91156726", "91264775"]
    }
  ]
  ,
  "not_prompt_issues": [
    "Some call drops are due to telephony/network issues (e.g., call lasted 3 seconds, buyer hung up immediately, or bot was cut off by the system). These are not fixable by prompt changes and should be logged as technical issues.",
    "Language barrier (Malayalam) is handled correctly by the bot; the caller's continued use of Malayalam after the bot's Hindi/English prompt is a caller-side issue."
  ]
}
